subject: general
question: The compound interest on a principal in 3 years is 33.1% of the principal if the interest is compounded annually. Find the rate of interest per annum:
solution:
**Given data:**

Compound interest (CI) = 33.1% of the principal.

Time (t) = 3 years

**Concept:**

The formula of compound interest,

A = P(1 + r/100)t.

**Solution:** 

CI = 33.1% of Principal (P)

⇒ Amount (A) after 3 years = P + 33.1% of P = P(1 + 0.331)

In the compound interest formula,

A = P(1 + r/100)³,

substitute given values

⇒ P(1 + 0.331) = P(1 + r/100)³

⇒ (1 + 0.331) = (1 + r/100)³

⇒ {∛(1 + 0.331)} = 1 + r/100

⇒ {∛(1.331)} - 1 = r/100

⇒ 1.1 - 1 = r/100

⇒ r = 0.1 × 100 = 10%

**Therefore, the rate of interest per annum is 10%.**
